Who was the founder of Common Weal and New India newspapers?
x:
Annie Besant was a prominent Theosophist, educationist, social reformer and nationalist leader. She played a vital role in India's freedom movement through her writings, speeches and the Home Rule Movement. To spread nationalist ideas and mobilize public opinion, she founded two influential newspapers: • New India – A daily newspaper that strongly advocated self-government, constitutional reforms and Indian nationalism. • Common Weal – A weekly journal that discussed political, educational and social issues while supporting the Home Rule Movement. Through these newspapers, Annie Besant criticized British policies and inspired educated Indians to participate actively in the national movement. She also founded the Home Rule League in 1916 and became the first woman President of the Indian National Congress in 1917.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Newspapers – New India and Common Weal
